product_metadata.title: Ryhpez Gray Shower Curtain Liner with Metal Hooks - Waterproof 8G EVA Bathroom Shower Curtain Set with Magnets and Rings | 72"x72"
features: ECO-FRIENDLY - Our shower curtain liner is made of EVA material which is non-toxic, waterproof and soft touch. It is the material which is also widely used for baby's toy.

METAL HOOKS & GROMMETS - The hooks are designed to be semi-circular to reduce friction with the rod. There are five small roller balls at the top of the ring, the smooth-rolling ball makes the rings to glide effortlessly across your shower rod. Rust protection metal grommets to prevent damage from humidity and reduce the risk of rusting like that metal hooks. Also convenience for hanging.

MULTIPURPOSE - The Pure Color shower curtain is ideal for shower stall and Bathtub at home, campers, apartments, hotels, dorms, athletic club and more. Also could be used as a stand-alone curtain or as a liner for a cloth shower curtain.

HEAVY DUTY & EASY CARE - There are 3 magnets at the bottom to keep the curtain stay in place. Prevent water from splashing out of the shower stall to make your bathroom dry and clean. Easy to clean, Just use a cloth to clean it.
SPECIFICATION - Thick 0.2mm(8-Gauge) , Standard 72"W x 72"H(183x183cm). Package include: 1 Shower Curtain Liner with Metal Grommets, 12Pcs Hooks(Rod Not Included).
